input.change_text: GHSA-f65r-h4g3-3h9h (CRITICAL): backprop ui --auth and backprop ui --share do not enforce authentication. In backpropagate >= 1.1.0, the optional Reflex web UI (`backprop ui`) exposes a training control plane (dataset upload, model load, training start/stop, GGUF export, HuggingFace push). The CLI accepts `--auth user:pass` and `--share` flags documented as security controls, but the Reflex backend never reads `BACKPROPAGATE_UI_AUTH` — no auth middleware is registered. Any client reaching the bound port has full UI access. Affected: pip backpropagate >= 1.1.0, < 1.2.0; npm @mcptoolshop/backpropagate >= 1.1.0, < 1.2.0. CWE-358, CWE-862, CWE-1295.

output.action_text: Upgrade `backpropagate` to 1.2.0+ (pip OR `@mcptoolshop/backpropagate@1.2.0` npm) to patch GHSA-f65r-h4g3-3h9h (CRITICAL). Pre-fix, `backprop ui --auth user:pass` printed `Auth: enabled` but the Reflex backend never read the credential — any client reaching the port had full UI access (dataset read, training control, HF push). Audit hosts that ran `--share` for exposed training data and rotate HF tokens used in those sessions.
